question: Which country won the bronze at the men's Hockey Asia Cup 2022 in Jakarta?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India defeated Japan** 5-3 in the** bronze medal **match of the **Men's Hockey Asia Cup 2022** held in** Jakarta, Indonesia.**
 
• This was India's** second consecutive** bronze medal in the tournament, having won it in **2017** as well.
